Complete front photograph of a CGC Pristine 10 Simplified Chinese Eevee & Snorlax GX CSM2.1C 054/045 card. physicalObservation.basis: The exact physical card is fully visible with a reflective rainbow face, and the paired CGC certification label explicitly designates the card Holo.
